# KitMint

> KitMint is a free, privacy-first browser utility hub for digital creators and e-commerce sellers. All tools run 100% client-side with zero server uploads.

## Core Tools
- **Client-Side Image Optimizer & Converter**: Compress PNG, JPG, and WebP images locally using HTML5 Canvas with custom quality sliders.
- **E-Commerce Profit & Margin Calculator**: Calculate net profit per unit, profit margin percentages, and break-even ROAS across multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, INR).
- **SEO Text & Snippet Formatter**: Live character/word counter, case converter, and Google Title Tag (60 chars) & Meta Description (160 chars) length checker.
